content: Fabric Loom 1.14 (Dec 2024) introduced plugin ids net.fabricmc.fabric-loom (non-obfuscated MC versions, 26.1+) and net.fabricmc.fabric-loom-remap (obfuscated MC versions, 1.21.11 and older, including 1.20.1). Legacy 'fabric-loom' id still works for obfuscated versions. Loom requires Gradle 9.2+ as of 1.14; current Loom 1.17.x resolves and builds MC 1.20.1 with official Mojang mappings without modification.
